s: Minhag kapparot beereb yom kippur ubo v' seipim: nohagin beellu haaratzot liqqach beereb yom hakkippurim tarnegol kappara lezakar vetarnegolet linqeba, veomerim alayv "zeh chalipati zeh temurati zeh kapparati veku'", (rashe tebot cht"k) zeh hashshem hachotek chayyim lekol chay, umachaziro sebib rosho, veyomar "bene adam ku'", veosin ken g' peamim. Vesomekin alayv yedehem dugmat semika beqorban, veshochatin oto miyyad, detekep lismika — shechita. Veyesh nimnain millismok alayv yedehem, kede shello yehe nireh kemaqdish qadashim veshochatan bachutz. Veen lachosh lazeh, kevan shehattarnegol hu dabar sheeno rauy lammizbeach. Abal im en lo tarnegolim veloqeach shear baale chayyim lekappara — lo yiqqach torim ubene yona shehem reuyim lammizbeach, veim yismok yadayv alehem yehe nireh kemaqdish qadashim veshochatan bachutz:

Ubocharin betarnegolim lebanim, al derek shenneemar "im yihyu chataekem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu". Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehallebanim mezummanim lepanayv az yibchar bahem mibbaacherim, abal im enam mezummanim lepanayv — lo yechazzer acharehem bedavqa, mishshum shezzehu keen darke haemori, sheddarkam lechazzer achar tarnegolim lebanim lehaqriban laaboda zara, uketib "ubechuqqotehem lo teleku":

Yesh nohagin liptor kamma zekarim betarnegol echad vekamma neqebot betarnegolet achat, lepikak en loqechin limubberet ella tarnegol echad vetarnegolet achat, deim haubbar zakar — hare yesh kan tarnegol echad, veim haubbar neqeba — day lah uleimmah betarnegolet achat. Veyesh nohagin liqqach kappara lekol echad veechad bipne atzmo, lepikak loqechin limubberet g' — shette neqebot vezakar echad:

Venohagin litten hakkapparot laaniyyim. Veyoter tob lipdot hakkappara bemamon ulechalleq hammamon laaniyyim, kede shello yitbayyeshu haaniyyim bemah shennotenim lahem hattarnegolim shellaqechu lekappara:

Veyesh meqomot shennahagu lelek al haqqebarot leharbot sham bitzdaqa, uminhag yapeh hu. Vehatztzedaqa shennotenim sham hu pidyon hakkapparot, ulekak rauy latet kepi erek hakkapparot sheyyesh lo bebeto. Velo yomar shum techinna, raq mah shemmeyussad miqqadmonim, shehare en omerim tachanun beyom zeh:

Vezoreqin habbene meayim vehakkabed vehakkelayot shel hakkapparot al haggaggot o bechatzer, maqom shehaopot yekolim laqachat mishsham, lepi sherauy lerachem al habberiyyot beyom zeh kede sheyyerachamu alenu min hashshamayim:
